cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Stay Until We’re Okay
cards.instruction: Keep someone present until the relationship feels repaired, even if the practical reason for staying disappears.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. Don't call the taxi yet. We're packed, but we haven't settled last night. Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I apologised for telling my sister about your debt.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. Stay a minute. I can't face her checking what I order tonight.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: She's already paid for dinner. We'll be late.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then we'll be late. Sit with me and help me believe you're coming as my partner, not to report how grateful I am.

mechanism: A directs departure but postpones it for relational reassurance, offering B control of the call and wording to secure continued presence.
confusable: Unlike merely delaying dinner, A seeks trust after a disclosure; borrowed authority presents concessions as a managed departure plan.
comparison: Couple debt disclosure and paid dinner differ from a guest finishing cleanup and catching a bus.
seedUse: Use D74-b debt disclosure/sister/paid dinner and S02-b adapting the method while maintaining command.
